input.user_message: I already hit my deductible. What will I owe for an outpatient shoulder scope next month?

expert_reasoning: Deductible-met path. With the deductible met, expected responsibility is ~20% coinsurance on the allowed amount, capped by remaining OOP-max headroom. Tyndale returns a band tied to the FAIR Health allowed-amount range and names the coinsurance + OOP-cap assumptions. Known numbers (coinsurance %, OOP met) are Tier A exact; the estimate framing is Tier C.
